name: Web Application and API
description: Normalized from OWASP WSTG, ASVS, and public hunting repositories.

items.guidance: Google dorking, WHOIS queries, and Certificate Transparency logs.
Enumerate subdomains via passive OSINT datasets and active bruteforcing.
Identify frameworks, languages, web servers, and versions.
Scan for hidden endpoints, backups (.bak, .old), and exposed configs (.git).
Analyze JavaScript bundles for hardcoded API keys, test environments, and secrets.
Inspect robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and security headers (security.txt).
Verify users cannot access peers' data (IDOR testing).
Confirm standard users cannot reach administrative actions or endpoints.
Attempt to access internal pages directly via URL manipulation without authentication.
Test header manipulation (X-Forwarded-For, X-Original-URL) to bypass gateways.
Test for default credentials, weak passwords, and lack of account lockouts.
Look for MFA bypass vectors (direct endpoint access, static response manipulation).
Check cookies for Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite flags.
Validate tokens are invalidated on logout and timeout.
Verify tokens change after login and are not predictable.
Test inputs, headers, and parameters for error-based, boolean, and time-based SQLi.
Probe inputs for reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS.
Inject payloads to test for RCE via OS commands.
Test unrestricted uploads (extension bypass, magic bytes, achieving execution).
Force the app to make unintended internal or external requests.
Attempt parameter stuffing to modify protected properties (e.g. isAdmin true).
Test for missing rate limits on login, forgot-password, and OTP.
Attempt out-of-order execution (e.g. skipping payment in checkout).
Check for exposed Swagger, OpenAPI, or GraphiQL playgrounds.
